Subject: Acme SOC 2 & security recap / next steps

Hi Alice —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap from our discovery so everyone is aligned and we have clear next steps. Please let me know if I missed anything.

Key pain points you called out:
- Need for SOC 2 Type II evidence and an easy way to surface pen-test artifacts to internal auditors.
- Audit log retention and exportability (7 years preferred; primary ask is 24 months accessible immediately).
- Contractual DPA terms around subprocessor notifications and data deletion windows.
- Clarification on log redaction & PII handling for customer-supplied data in prompts.

Goals we heard:
- Complete security evaluation by your InfoSec team by end of November.
- Confirm DPA language and retention policy before procurement sign-off.
- Validate pen-test summary and SOC 2 scope aligns with your control requirements.

What Redwood can provide (high level):
- SOC 2 Type II summary and scoped control matrix; full report available under NDA.
- Audit log endpoints with exportable CSV/JSON; default retention 12 months with configurable extensions (we can propose 24 months for your account).
- DPA template and a summary of our subprocessors; we can accept a few redlines depending on enterprise plan.
- Pen test summary and remediation timeline; full findings available via secured link for reviewers.

Action items / owners:  (dates are target)
1) Redwood to share SOC 2 summary, pen-test summary, and control matrix — Marissa (by 10/13).
2) Acme to confirm required retention window (24 months vs 7 years) and whether export needs to be handed to third-party auditors — Alice (by 10/16).
3) Legal/Procurement sync: exchange DPA template and flag any non-starters — Dev (coordinate with Alice, target 10/20).
4) Schedule follow-up technical deep-dive on logging endpoints & redaction with Rishi and your InfoSec — Marissa + Rishi (schedule for week of 10/19).

Attachments: redwood-soc2-summary.pdf (summary), redwood-pen-test-summary.pdf (summary) — full report available via NDA / secure link.

If that all looks right I’ll send the secure links and propose time slots for the deep-dive.

Best,

Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai
+1 (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa — this is great and matches our notes. A couple of clarifications from InfoSec: 

- For audit log retention we are asking for 24 months of accessible logs and the ability to export a full set for a third-party auditor. 7 years is our long-term retention goal but we can stage that (24 months first, then archival export).
- On the SOC 2: we will need the Type II report or an executive summary plus a matrix that maps your controls to our requirements. Full report can be shared under NDA.
- DPA: our procurement team will circulate a few non-negotiables (IP carveouts and data deletion SLAs). Please have your legal team ready to review.

Can you send the secure link to the SOC 2 Type II executive summary and the pen test summary? Also please propose 3 slots for the technical deep-dive next week (10/19-10/23).

Appreciate the quick follow-up.

— Alice
Alice Johnson

Hi Alice —

Thanks for the clarifications. Quick notes from the technical side and links to the artifacts:

1) Retention & exports:
- We can configure your account for 24 months of hot (immediately queryable) audit log retention.
- Exports: we provide an export endpoint and can also produce a one-time export bundle (JSON/CSV) for auditors.
- Long-term archival to 7 years would be via secure cold storage; we can discuss cost/ingestion details if you want to move to that model.

2) SOC 2 & pen test artifacts:
- Executive summary and scoped control matrix: https://redwood.app/soc2-packages/acme (protected link; full report requires NDA).
- Pen test summary: attached (redwood-pen-test-summary.pdf). For highly sensitive reviewers we can create a reviewer access token.

3) Data handling & redaction:
- Default behavior: request metadata and non-customer PII are redacted from long-term logs. We can enable additional redaction rules per customer account, e.g., regex-based redaction for SSNs or tokens.

4) DPA & subprocessors:
- Dev will follow up with our DPA template and subprocessors list. We typically accept limited procurement redlines for enterprise plans; major legal changes may require a short review cycle.

Proposed deep-dive slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-10-20 09:00–10:00
- Wed 2026-10-21 14:00–15:00
- Thu 2026-10-22 11:00–12:00

Let me know which one works and I’ll put together an agenda focused on log export examples, retention configuration, and redaction settings.

Thanks,
